description: Aside is an AI browser that performs tasks across websites, accounts, browsing history, and files. Its help center documents browser features, AI-provider configuration, account use, and local developer tools.
summary: Aside exposes a local `aside` CLI and a local MCP server launched via `aside mcp`; both depend on being signed in to an Aside account in the Aside browser. No public HTTP/REST, GraphQL, or hosted MCP endpoint on aside.com was documented.

surfaces.name: Aside MCP server (local via CLI stdio)
